note: Held out of the visible suite. The two v1 cases that used to sit here were retired with the v1 format on 2026-09-25; these two sdd/v2 cases replace them because nothing in current work touches export fingerprints or consumer pins, so holding them back still gives each round a result it was not aiming at.

cases.statement: The producer's exported semantics (R9) no longer match the fingerprint recorded with export version 1, so a consumer pinned to v1 cannot tell which text it agreed to.
cases.root_cause: Export versions are free text; nothing binds them to the clauses a consumer relies on.

cases.statement: The consumer pins dependency-planner v1 with a fingerprint that predates the producer's current semantics.
cases.root_cause: A consumer pin carries no fingerprint check.
